verdict.rationale: Airweave is a data-sync and retrieval layer for agents, so access governance and auditing over its stored knowledge is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no roles, policies, ACLs, or access-audit logs; webhooks only notify about syncs and collection changes, not who read or wrote data. A community question about how Airweave will solve RBAC is an open question, not evidence either way.
